text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre showed remarkable growth during 
summer training camp. Near the end of the 
camp, that power was nearing completion—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hah! Haaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! What an incredible final 
sprint...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"With this... the Classic Triple Crown is 
practically guaranteed!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. As long as the race runs 
normally... the winner will undoubtedly be 
Orfevre!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Man, the hype is going to be unreal...! 
Back when the last Triple Crown Umamusume 
was born, it was simply out of this 
world...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Orfevre is strong. I knew just how strong 
she was from the Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo 
Yushun (Japanese Derby). That's why, up 
until now, I had no doubts whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As her Trainer, I wanted to take the 
victory deemed certain for her and *make* 
it certain. Without getting cocky, I 
wanted to think about what more I could 
do."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Is that what you want? The past analysis 
data for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur is a Double Crown Umamusume who 
won the Satsuki Sho and Kikuka Sho, with 
exceptional data analysis skills. So, I 
asked for her help.
choice_data_list:
I wanted to make your victory in the 
Kikuka Sho rock-solid!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah. Rock-solid, huh? Someone's full of 
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still... your trainee was Orfevre, wasn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If it's her data... it should be extremely 
useful.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's a trade-off. Got a problem with that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't hand over Orfevre's personal data. 
However, I do have the analysis notebooks 
I've personally compiled from watching her 
and the Umamusume around her.
choice_data_list: If you're fine with that, sure!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, that's more than enough to cover 
it. Thanks for your business~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even among Umamusume, Orfevre's abilities 
must be extraordinary. If that's the case, 
then there is still only one thing for me 
to do—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And through various research and trials, 
we finally perfected a satisfying menu for 
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eager to put it to use in training right 
away, I waited enthusiastically for 
Orfevre. However...

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I believe the King is likely at 
Prince Journey's residence...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Trainer. There you are.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I don't recall inviting you. Leave.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Don't make me say it twice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved the Double Crown and shown 
growth at summer camp, Orfevre had been in 
high spirits lately, but...
choice_data_list: ...Could you tell me why you won't come?
...Could you tell me why you won't come?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer, a moment?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Leave this to me. Why don't you head back 
for now?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No. But... I have a general idea of what 
to expect.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do my best to persuade her to join 
training tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Do you mean you'll find the reason for 
Orfevre's foul mood yourself and resolve 
it on your own?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...I see. My apologies for that."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall refrain. Please contact 
me anytime if anything comes up.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, just to be sure... Though I suppose 
this might be unneeded meddling on my 
part."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It seems the seeds of her foul mood were 
planted back during the summer training 
camp... So it might run pretty deep, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Searching further back in my memory, I 
suddenly remembered what happened right 
before the summer training camp started.

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Visitor numbers still seem to be 
down as well...

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
The mood of self-restraint continues, 
but... it would be nice if talking about 
her could serve as an opportunity to look 
forward, even just a little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, when I was talking 
with the reporters... They mentioned that 
"the last Triple Crown was a massive 
sensation."
choice_data_list:
（……Do you feel that's no longer the 
case?）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking into it again, the Derby 
attendance in the year the previous Triple 
Crown Umamusume was born was actually 
higher than this year's.
choice_data_list:
(Things are different now than they were 
back then, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given the state of the world, it is 
inevitable that fewer people are visiting 
the racecourse than back then. However, 
Orfevre will not accept that.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: By royal decree. Raise your head.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: And now, behold my running! This is light!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Prostrate yourselves and worship. I shall 
illuminate you all—far and wide.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Because a king is one who captures all 
hearts. In that case, what I must do to 
resolve Orfevre's dissatisfaction is...”
choice_data_list:
To make the Kikuka Sho as exciting as 
possible!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—In short, Trainer, you wish to pursue a 
grassroots campaign, is that it?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I want to draw crowds to Kyoto 
Racecourse!

Yeah, I want to draw crowds to Kyoto 
Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With everyone's cooperation, we make 
appeals on social media and around town. 
If our vast number of subjects join 
forces, we should be able to reach a great 
many people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surely there are people who want to come 
see the races, but feel they can't. If we 
could give those people a little push—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If we can fill the racetrack with 
people's fervor... then Orfevre will truly 
be satisfied, in the deepest sense.
choice_data_list: That view is truly what she deserves...!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Of course! If it is for the 
King, I shall never refuse.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
"I'll ask for some action on Lady 
Orfevre's fansite as well. The subjects 
managing it are acquaintances of mine!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me help out as well. I have 
quite a few connections, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Please continue to look after Orfe... 
from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The promotional campaign for the Kikuka 
Sho, driven by the united efforts of the 
populace, gradually spread from person to 
person...

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I should head over and watch the 
race soon."

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I was wondering about that too! I 
saw the post about the "Kikuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Maybe this could be a good opportunity... 
to try mustering up some courage—

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
—We already settled the matter about 
withdrawing, didn't we? What's there to 
talk about now?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
Wanna all go watch the upcoming Kikuka Sho 
together? I'll cover the travel expenses 
to Kyoto.

text_block_list.name: Band Member A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ah, I think I saw something about 
that online. Orfevre's running, right? Not 
that it has anything to do with us 
anymore—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
"I found it. The answer to what we can 
do."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text: Please! Let's go—to the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer C
text_block_list.text:
My King, look. The term 'Triple Crown 
Umamusume' is trending on social media. 
...They must be referring to you, My King.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...This gritty, down-and-dirty style... 
Could it be that guy?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I'm coming in.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A staff serves the King. It is only 
natural.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
As are your efforts. Devotion is your 
duty.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However... humans are fragile. Without 
water, they wither away in no time.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You do not wither. Why do your roots 
continue to spread?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For her, that's surprisingly 
straightforward phrasing. She must be that 
curious... as to why I keep following her 
without breaking.
choice_data_list: ...I want to see it for myself.
...I want to see it for myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a strength so fierce it fills you 
with longing. With a brilliance like a 
dream. Witnessing Orfevre tread the path 
of absolute dominion, transcending both 
past and future...
choice_data_list:
I want to watch by their side as the king 
I serve becomes a legend!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh... I see.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...You must have a menu for the 'Kikuka 
Sho', right?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Make ready at once. Before I change my 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Orfevre's motivation rising, 
preparations were steadily underway. 
Winning the Kikuka Sho, and then—becoming 
a Triple Crown Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“Let us witness the birth of a Triple 
Crown Umamusume at Kyoto Racecourse”...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Haha. So it's already completely set in 
stone, huh."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ... ...Don't mess with me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: This time for sure... I'll do it.
